# aria2 — Third-Party Component

RomGoGetter Community Edition includes aria2, an independent open-source download utility.

## Component Information

- **Project:** aria2
- **Version:** 1.37.0
- **Executable:** `data/aria2c.exe`
- **Platform:** Windows x64
- **License:** GNU General Public License v2.0 or later
- **Original project:** https://github.com/aria2/aria2
- **Official release:** https://github.com/aria2/aria2/releases/tag/release-1.37.0
